_doc: PROMOTE-1 (owner, 2026-11-14): strategy and promotion are the system's job, never the owner's. Every route that can carry Ultrastable to people or to other systems is a channel here. foundation/promote.py scores each channel (reach x fit x weight / cost), where fit is computed from the channel's `requires` against outreach/facts.json (a failed requirement makes the channel not-a-fit-now with that fact as its re-entry trigger), runs or files the credential-free ones as executor items (docs/issues/Q-PROMO-*.json), and folds identity-bound ones into the single existing NEEDS-YOU card with a prepared kit. Outcomes (`promote --outcome`) re-weight channels. `needs` is none (system runs it), or owner-identity with a `gate` naming the identity-bound act (statement in the owner's name, owner account, sender postal address, money).

channels.signal: YC decision email, recorded with scripts/outreach.py reply ultrastable:B-YC
NLnet reply, recorded with scripts/outreach.py reply ultrastable:A-NLNET
credit grant email per programme (B-CF, B-GSTART, B-AWS, B-MSFT, B-NVIDIA)
registry search returns io.github.ultrastable/ultrastable; agent hits on /mcp

channels.route: scripts/social_post.py fed by foundation/reach.py (events to posts); posts when the account bindings exist
channels.signal: social referrals in first-party hits (reach metric social_referrals_7d)

channels.audience: Nonprofits, mutual-aid groups, libraries and community centres with small teams and routine work (intake, scheduling, newsletters)
channels.route: intro-email segment third-sector, role mailboxes published on each organization's own pages

channels.audience: Civic-tech and open-source-for-good communities (Code for America brigades, Open Collective projects, volunteer developer groups)
channels.route: a post or Show-and-tell in their public forums, drafted by the system and posted only after the owner consents in the owner's own account
channels.signal: referrals and replies from those forums in first-party hits

channels.route: scripts/social_post.py fed by foundation/reach.py (events to posts); posts when the account bindings exist
